newsitem.title: USA: EDO names Fariello chairman, adding duties.
newsitem.headline: EDO names Fariello chairman, adding duties.

text.p: The board of directors of EDO Corp said Wednesday it had named its chief executive officer, Frank Fariello, to the additional position of chairman of the board.
The company said Fariello, 62, would succeed Robert Hanisee, who continues as a director of EDO, which sells electronic and mechanical products to defense contractors.
And in a prepared statement, the company said Fariello had named Ira Kaplan as executive vice president and chief operating officer.
The statement said the board had approved a new compensation plan for its directors, increasing the minimum number of common shares required to be held by a director to 1,000 from 100.

The new plan requires at least half of an outside director's retainer to be taken in common shares of EDO and establishes a new stock option plan for outside directors, subject to shareholder approval, the statement said.
Kaplan, 61, has been corporate vice president and general manager of the company's Defense and Space Systems Division.
"His new responsibilities as chief operating officer will extend to all the business units of the company," Fariello said.
The post is a newly created position, the company said.
